system.description:
Starting at 3rd level, you begin to become familiar with yourself and how others come to terms with themselves. You gain proficiency in Chakra Control, Insight and Ninshou if you are not already. When you would make a skill check using Insight, you can use Intelligence in place of Wisdom.

Additionally, when you would make a Insight check using Intelligence or Wisdom, you can spend one superiority dice adding it to your checks result.

source.custom: Imported full source rules; contextual benefits require adjudication.
